common_mask: E2_100 intersect E2_500, per seed/stream/offset; shared across arms and weights
source_rule: D0 FP32 supports, state-specific frozen IDs; current embeddings retain gradients
auxiliary: mean over frozen eligible rows of softplus(extra_logit - full_native_row_logpartition); detached logit_scale; differentiable partition
selection: first ordered support member; never reselect, including Select representatives
synthesis: equal weights .5 on two frozen IDs, reference mixed-precision matrix product, normalize eps=1e-12
empty_mask: fatal before training; no skip, fallback or change of population
mixture_validity: finite with norm >1e-6; fatal, never fallback

calibration.aggregate: mean of four individual masked auxiliary/native raw gradient norm ratios
calibration.common_rng: checkpoint100 restored for every observational call

analysis.averaging: streams within seed then equal seeds
analysis.scope: effect on full reporting pool of a masked intervention conditional on common eligible training exposures
analysis.crossover: Q100 > 0 and Q500 < 0; negative Delta alone is not crossover
analysis.absolute_usefulness: D<0 relative to native; relative preference alone insufficient

recovery: no automatic resume or surviving-branch analysis; partial records synced after each real update; explicit inspected recovery only
provenance: completed authenticated D0; reused development seeds and reporting pool
